mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over the prior month compresses discount rates for equity valuations, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days without regime dependence.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of instances where FEDFUNDS declines over the prior month, or Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate exceeds 4.5% for three consecutive months, it signals labor market weakness that reduces consumer spending and corporate earnings growth, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances where UNRATE > 4.5% for 3 consecutive months, or Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) over the prior month indicates broad consumer demand contraction that depresses corporate revenue expectations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances where both HOUST and RSAFS decline over the prior month, or Rank IC for interaction term over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: In a high interest rate regime (FEDFUNDS > 4.0%), a consumer price index above 3.5% annually signals persistent inflation requiring further rate hikes, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances where CPIAUCSL > 3.5% and FEDFUNDS > 4.0%, or Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production (INDPRO) over the prior month signals manufacturing sector contraction that reduces corporate earnings growth expectations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances where INDPRO declines over the prior month, or Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When housing starts (HOUST) fall below 1300 thousand units for two consecutive months, it indicates a severe housing market slowdown that reduces consumer confidence and corporate investment, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances where HOUST < 1300 for 2 consecutive months, or Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in non-farm payrolls (PAYEMS) and rise in unemployment rate (UNRATE) over the prior month indicates labor market deterioration that reduces household income and consumer spending, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances where PAYEMS declines and UNRATE rises over the prior month, or Rank IC for interaction term over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: In a high unemployment regime (UNRATE > 5%), a decline in the unemployment rate signals improving labor market conditions that boost consumer spending and corporate earnings, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: UNRATE declines by >0.1pp from previous month
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of instances where UNRATE > 5% and declines by >0.1pp from previous month, or Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.
